newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound rises slightly on dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound rises slightly on dlr demand.

text.p: The Egyptian pound rose slightly against the dollar in the private sector market on Monday which one banker said could be due to a demand for the U.S. currency by banks as the end of the fiscal year approaches.
Other bankers saw activity as generally unremarkable.
Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3950 to 3.3960 pounds bid and 3.3960 to 3.3985 offered in the interbank market.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.39525 pounds bid and 3.39725 offered. The averages compared with 3.3945 pounds bid and 3.396875 offered on Monday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at opening as 3.390660 buy and 3.397984 sell.
